question: In the simulated MaleCNS connectome, are Johnston's organ zone C and zone E neurons present with exact identities on both sides, and does their wiring match the published structure (segregated direct targets, reach to descending neurons)?
feasibility_inspection_before_registrati: Annotation counts only: subclass wind_gravity 475, entryNerve AN; zone x rootSide counts (C 31 L / 22 R, E 157 L / 110 R, other B/D/F/A 34 L / 23 R, JO-unclear 6 L / 92 R); statusLabel 'RT Hard to trace' for all 475; superclass value counts (descending_neuron 1314). The earlier posture-sense inventory reported 2-hop reach of 178 wind_gravity neurons to leg MN pools (all zones pooled). No zone-specific connectivity was computed before registration.

populations.excluded_reported: JO-unclear and all other JO types are not in C or E; JO-unclear is reported per side

graph: simulated CSR, presynaptic rows, edges with synapse count >= 6 (engine min_synapses floor)
descending_targets: bodyIds with superclass == 'descending_neuron' present in the simulated index

checks.A1_identity: every C and E bodyId maps to exactly one dense index of the simulated connectome
checks.A2_bilateral: each of C-left, C-right, E-left, E-right has >= 10 matched neurons
checks.A3_zone_segregation: per side, weighted direct-target overlap between C and E, sum_t min(wC_t, wE_t) / sum_t max(wC_t, wE_t), with w_t the summed synapses (edges >= 6) from the set onto target t (all targets), is < 0.5 on both sides
checks.A4_descending_reach: per side, at least one C neuron and at least one E neuron reach a descending neuron by a direct edge or a two-hop path (all edges >= 6)

verdict.IDENTITY_PARTIAL: A1 and A2 pass, A3 or A4 fails

reported_not_gated: per zone x side: neurons reaching each leg's MN pools (all joint classes pooled) within two hops
descending neurons reached within two hops per zone x side: exact bodyIds and types, direct synapses
left/right ratio of C and E neuron counts and of total output synapses (edges >= 6)
weighted direct-target overlap of right JO-unclear with right C and with right E (descriptive; never used to assign)
interpretation_limits: Data only: structural consistency, not function or transduction.
Zone sign (which zone prefers which deflection) is not addressed here; Step B tests G1 against G1_FLIP.
All JO neurons carry statusLabel 'RT Hard to trace'; right-side typing is incomplete (92 JO-unclear).
Published structure is cited from memory (Kamikouchi et al. 2009) and used as a hypothesis.
single_run: Executed once after protocol, code and tests are committed.
